archetypes.name: kv-wire-contract
archetypes.rationale: The 12-key KV allowlist, WARN dedup rule, file-first vs stdout-fallback precedence, and rc!=0 override conditions are each stated in at least three places (SKILL.md fence spec, run-step3-review.sh spec, test-step3-orchestrator-fence.sh coverage) and subtle divergence between them would cause split-brain behavior.
archetypes.prompt_body: Check that every KV-protocol rule in the plan is stated identically across all files that encode it: the 12-key allowlist membership, the WARN-replay-only constraint (never display-echo), the display-pass exclusion predicate, the _step3_safe_env_loaded binding condition (-f && ! -L), file-first precedence (stdout fills only missing keys), the qualified rc!=0 override (no-safe-env path only), and exit-2-before-normalize ordering. Look for divergences where one spec says 'overwrite' and another says 'fill missing', where override conditions differ between the driver spec and the SKILL.md thin-fence spec, or where the harness test cases assert a rule not present in the plan text. Flag any rule that appears in one file spec but is absent or subtly different in another. Cite specific file paths and line ranges for any issues found, and follow the output-format rules from your outer wrapper exactly.

archetypes.name: sentinel-touch-contract
archetypes.rationale: The sentinel ownership transfer from emit-design-plan-preview.sh to run-step3-review.sh --preview-only introduces several conditional touch rules (output-string match, allowlist-gated, invalid-tmpdir suppression, stale-sentinel re-entry) that must be consistent between the .sh spec, .md doc, and test harness coverage.
archetypes.prompt_body: Verify that the sentinel touch conditions are stated consistently across the run-step3-review.sh update spec, run-step3-review.md update spec, emit-design-plan-preview.sh update spec (pure renderer, no touch), and test-run-step3-review.sh coverage. Check every conditional: touch only when tmpdir validates AND output contains the plan header or exact missing-plan warning; no touch for non-header stub, allowlist-invalid tmpdir, renderer non-zero exit with non-header body, or bare missing plan.txt; re-entry suppression only when sentinel exists AND tmpdir validates; stale sentinel on invalid tmpdir must not suppress warnings. Look for gaps where a conditional listed in the .sh spec is absent from .md or untested in the harness, or where the emit-design-plan-preview.sh spec still implies sentinel ownership it should have surrendered. Cite specific file paths and line ranges for any issues found, and follow the output-format rules from your outer wrapper exactly.

archetypes.name: doc-reference-sweep
archetypes.rationale: The plan removes the direct emit-design-plan-preview.sh --variant step3 SKILL.md fence and touches 7 documentation files; any residual reference to the removed direct-call pattern or absent reference to the new two-fence shape is an operator-visible contract bug.
archetypes.prompt_body: Check that no file in the plan's scope still describes the removed direct `emit-design-plan-preview.sh --variant step3` SKILL.md fence as a current orchestration step, and that the new two-fence pattern (uncaptured run-step3-review.sh --preview-only followed by captured --no-preview) is consistently described across SKILL.md, run-step3-review.md, emit-design-plan-preview.md, docs/configuration-and-permissions.md Chat-order note, docs/issue-anchored-plan.md Plan-adequacy section, docs/linting.md harness prose, and SECURITY.md allowlist contract. Also verify that the plan's 'drift sweep' step (step 6) explicitly covers all seven files and that the structure-test pins for removed fat-fence strings are consistent with the doc updates. Flag any file where the plan prescribes an update but leaves the specific changed sentence or section underspecified. Cite specific file paths and line ranges for any issues found, and follow the output-format rules from your outer wrapper exactly.
